body: CASSIEL, the archangel who renounced the gods and became a mortal man, leader of the Grigori in the fantasy game Fall from Heaven: once an archangel, now wingless and mortal; male; ageless, looking about fifty; tall and lean. IVORY-WHITE SKIN like polished marble, finely carved noble features, long straight pale-gold hair with the first grey at the temples, deep grey eyes.
costume: a plain deep royal-blue robe with a high black collar and bronze clasps, a bronze-buckled belt, no holy symbols.
signature: Fine HAIRLINE CRACKS like those in an old marble statue run across his ivory skin at the temples, throat and backs of the hands, a faint cold white light showing in them.
extra: What is left of the angel in him is uncanny, though he has no wings and his eyes are human grey: his face is too symmetrical and too calm for a mortal, like a statue that has learned to breathe; he never blinks; and the air around him is wrong: dust motes, smoke and candle flames near him hang motionless, as if he were the still centre of the room.

vibes.name: Unmade Angel
vibes.line: Holding one long shed white feather across his left palm and drawing his right thumb down its vane, face calm and unreadable, eyes straight on the viewer; alone on the palace roof at midnight, a faint outline of starlight behind him where vast wings once were; cold blue-silver light.
vibes.wears: the stripped remains of his angelic war-gear: a breastplate of pale white bronze, its holy sigils chiselled off and its gem settings empty, over a plain charcoal-grey undertunic.

vibes.name: Godless Freedom
vibes.line: Letting a gold holy sunburst drop from his right hand over the parapet, his left hand coiling its empty chain round his fingers, his back to a sky of blazing holy rays; eyes on the free city of bronze domes, guild towers and harbour below, a quiet smile; bright midmorning.
vibes.wears: a free citizen's travelling gear: a weathered brown leather jerkin and bracers, a rust-red wool cloak, a belt of pouches with a small bronze guild token, worn boots.

vibes.name: Sees Ghosts
vibes.line: Lowering his right hand to let the ghost of a white cat rub against his fingertips, his left hand gripping the bronze arm of his throne; brows drawn up in sorrow, eyes following the drifting dead through the haze of his bronze-and-black throne hall; pale-gold afternoon light on him alone.
vibes.wears: his throne-room robe of plain deep royal-blue wool with a high black collar and bronze clasps, a bronze-buckled belt, no holy symbols anywhere.

vibes.name: Marble Mortal
vibes.line: Holding up a single grey hair just pulled from his temple between finger and thumb, his other hand tilting a small tarnished bronze hand mirror away from himself; eyes narrowed on the hair, mouth tight; a bare stone bedchamber at first light, cold grey-blue dawn through one narrow window.
vibes.wears: a plain undyed linen nightshirt with a rough oatmeal wool blanket pulled around his shoulders, like any ageing man woken too early.
